description: Access your Levanta brands, creators, products, and performance reports directly in ChatGPT. List the brands and creators on your team, pull product and commission details, and analyze seller performance — sales, ROAS, conversion, clicks, and more — in natural language. Build reports and surface insights across your affiliate and creator programs on Amazon, Shopify, and Walmart without leaving your ChatGPT workflow. Built for Levanta Sellers. Requires a Levanta seller account; sign in at app.levanta.io to authorize access.
